review_type: Author pixel inspection, not independent engineering or usability acceptance.
observed_treatment: All eight final PNGs were inspected at their natural 800px width. Every 390px presentation was inspected with 800px content retained in a scroll frame, not shrunk. The actual full gallery also supplies wrapping captions/prompts, exact IDs, source links and text alternatives. Dense PNGs scaled to 342px are not claimed readable.
findings_resolved: Receipt timeline headline shortened to preserve the intended margin.
Normal pickup caption changed to normal handoff because the sequence includes intake and later pickup.
R_ELAPSED trace alias shortened to Limit duration after a wrap escaped its card; all trace labels now participate in card bounds checks.
